description: Move a PAID hosted app or bot to another region, the move on its Settings tab. Pass region as a region name or part of one, for example "USA" or "Europe"; call it without a region to be told where the app runs now and which regions it may go to. The app is stopped while its files are copied and comes back up on its own, which takes a few minutes. A public port is kept only when it is free on the new host. The bundled database stays where it is and stays reachable over the owner private network. One move an hour per app: a second attempt inside the hour is refused and says when. Refuses a free app, whose placement is ours to choose. Refuses a region with no room or no host taking apps right now, an app that is already moving, deploying or restoring, and a paused app. Needs full access to the app.

app.description: The app id (bot_...) from list_bots. Must be on a paid tier.

region.description: The region to move to, as a name or part of one, for example "USA". Leave it out to read the current region and the regions this app may move to.

name: move_app_region

cooldown_seconds.description: Seconds until this app may be moved again, or null when it may be moved now.

current_region.description: The region the app runs in, or null while it has no host.

message.description: What happened or what the app may do.

movable.description: Whether this app may be moved at all. False for a free app.

moving.description: Whether a move is running now. While this is true nothing else about the app can be changed.

regions.description: Every region this app can be told about.

available.description: Whether a move there can start right now.

current.description: Whether the app runs there now.

reason.description: Why it cannot, when it cannot.

title: Move an app to another region
